title: Why does it always seem like there's a Dollar General on the edge of town? (editorial poster, 24x36)
version_note: First release, November 22, 2026. Editorial: no plate, no title block, not in the store. Whether it is ever sold is the owner's later decision; selling it means a plate and a store record (README "Editorial pieces (not for sale)").

run: python3 tools/stories/dollar-stores/poster.py <ds-dir> drafts/dollar-stores-virginia/casestudy/2026-11-21-09-replication/data/tests.csv drafts/dollar-stores-virginia/casestudy/2026-11-21-09-replication/data/dg_classes.csv <out>/dollar-stores-virginia-poster-1.0.0   # writes the .pdf (the art) and the .png (100 dpi)
python3 tools/stories/dollar-stores/figures.py drafts/dollar-stores-virginia/casestudy/2026-11-22-17-release/dollar-stores-virginia-poster-1.0.0.pdf   # the story page's pictures, into pages/
python3 tools/release/check.py --editorial viz-dollar-stores-virginia-poster --rebuild --data ds=<ds-dir>   # both of the above in a scratch folder, compared with this record
recipe.made_with: matplotlib 3.11.2 (the PDF's Producer and the PNG's Software tag); the Python, geopandas and Pillow versions were not logged at release
recipe.deterministic: The PNG is: the released PNG is byte-identical to rc2's, rendered about 80 minutes earlier. The PDF differs from rc2's only in its /CreationDate, which matplotlib stamps at render time.

ds.where: on the Mac, under ISO-TEST/isoscape-work/dollar-stores/ (raw downloads in its raw/); too large for git

external.ds: The working folder the poster reads (<ds-dir>): stores_dedup.csv.gz (every store, de-duplicated, with its place, class and distances), hpms/va2024.gpkg (FHWA HPMS 2024 Virginia, with traffic counts), counties/va_regions.gpkg (Census 2024 counties tagged with the five regions of tools/stories/dollar-stores/regions.json), fonts/ (Libre Baskerville from tools/print/fonts, converted to TTF), and one place folder per grid store in work_all/<slug> or work_cdp/<geoid> (place.gpkg, builtup.gpkg, roads.gpkg, meta.json). It was made from the raw downloads by the scripts in tools/stories/dollar-stores/, as drafts/dollar-stores-virginia/casestudy/log.md tells (steps 2 to 9). Kept on the Mac under ISO-TEST/isoscape-work/dollar-stores/ (the exact folder was not logged at release; the first rebuild there should confirm it); not in git.
external.hashed: These files were not hashed at release. When check.py --rebuild reproduces the poster from them, it writes their SHA-256 into reproduced.steps.poster.data_sha256.
external.sources: drafts/dollar-stores-virginia/sources.md: every download with its URL, date, size, SHA-256 (or the checksum file on the Mac that holds it) and license. Raw files: ISO-TEST/isoscape-work/dollar-stores/raw/ on the Mac.

shown.page_source: pages/dollar-stores.md, written by tools/stories/dollar-stores/page.py from story.md and counts.json (counts.py writes counts.json from the committed results). Not pinned here: the page can be corrected without changing the poster.
shown.pdfs: p/dollar-stores-phone.pdf and p/dollar-stores-large.pdf on gh-pages (tools/pdf/story_pdf.py dollar-stores), published at gh-pages commit e88635a
shown.shop: none: the page has shop: false
